title: Proposal: working together on SLC6A1-related disorders research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into SLC6A1-related disorders.
We are writing to SLC6A1 Connect because you support families affected by SLC6A1-related disorders.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
Published work links the disorders to loss of function and haploinsufficiency.
A link to reduced GABA reuptake has not yet been checked by a person, and misfolding is contested because about a third of variants reach the cell surface.
A prospective natural history study is recruiting, and people are included in the COMBINEDBrain natural history platform, Simons Searchlight and Citizen Health.
A phase 1/2 gene therapy study is enrolling by invitation, and a remote phase 2 phenylbutyrate trial is recruiting.
Evidence for phenylbutyrate is contested and largely from models and uncontrolled reports.
We would propose a study on [research question about SLC6A1-related disorders], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how your community or the natural history efforts you support might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
